info.name: Putting the Maple Leaf in my mouth...

descriptions.notStarted: I should go see #b#p9010010##k.  She said she was going to tell me some special information in light of MapleStory's 4 Year Anniversary...
descriptions.inProgress: Collect #t04001126#? It's hard to believe that it's a #b#t01012098##k... but it is said to be very potent.  It's not like I need to collect a large amount.  I should give it a try\n\n #i04001126# #t04001126# #b#c04001126##k / 50
descriptions.completed: I got a #b#t01012098##k!  After I put it in my mouth, I feel like my abilities increasing.  It feels invigorating.  Oh, but what if it doesn't increase the abilities I need?\n...I'll just go see #p9010010# in two hours.  I'm sure she'll know what to do.
